title: Pilate! Wy don’t you old back that owlin mob?
html_source: Pontius Pilate was the Roman military governor of Judea when Jesus was crucified. As a response to Public demand—an “owling mob”—he orders the Crucifixion.

anchor.text: Pilate! Wy don't you old back that owlin mob?

He had cleaned his teeth, he knew, with arecanut paste. 

 Father Conmee walked and, walking, smiled for he thought on Father Bernard Vaughan's droll eyes and cockney voice.
